name: Point-To-Point 20K (persistent sessions)
comments: clean_session false on both groups, so the broker keeps 40k persistent sessions.
Deliberately below the ~25.2k msg/s ceiling measured with persistence enabled.
Used to confirm that the ceiling - not per-message latency - is what makes the 50k
persistent run look slow: under the ceiling, latency should stay flat instead of
Each publisher pubs 1 message per second. QoS 1, payload 16B.
Connections are paced at 5000/s. Without it the client opens all of them as fast as it
can - 20000 CONNECTs in half a second, some 37000/s, a rate no deployment produces and
none of these scenarios ever claimed to measure. The connect phase is setup here, not the
measurement, which starts when publishing does.
